mibig_accession.definition: Original biological reference accession; unique primary key.

original_embedding_row.definition: Original zero-based CORE_ONLY row, retained exactly; augmentation rows are not observations.

original_bgcprophet_class.definition: Original label string used in clustering; never replaced by source chemotypes.

original_class_multilabel.definition: Original class tokens in original order as a JSON list; overlapping hybrid classes retained.

original_is_hybrid.definition: More than one original class token.

global_leiden_community.definition: Existing global joint baseline, k20_r1_s42; no recomputation.

is_saccharide_reference.definition: Any Saccharide token in original labels, including hybrids.
is_saccharide_reference.source: original labels and saved global assignment

is_GC08.source: original labels and saved global assignment

is_GC05.source: original labels and saved global assignment

is_saccharide_outside_GC08.source: original labels and saved global assignment

reference_core_gene_count.definition: Frozen CORE_ONLY reference gene count; distinct from all annotated CDS count.

is_priority_curation_reference.definition: Union of all Saccharide references and all GC08/GC05 references; 229 unique BGCs.

organism_name.definition: Original MIBiG organism string; no current taxonomy substitution.

ncbi_taxid.definition: Recorded taxon ID kept as text.

genus.definition: Lexical genus component of recorded organism name where unambiguous; not a new taxonomic determination.
genus.source: recorded organism string; conservative lexical parsing

species.definition: Recorded binomial component where unambiguous; strain text omitted without taxonomy lookup.
species.source: recorded organism string; conservative lexical parsing

broader_taxonomy.definition: Documented GenBank lineage, retained separately from JSON organism.

taxonomy_provenance.definition: Distinguishes recorded taxonomy and derived name components from new retrievals.

genbank_organism_name.definition: Frozen GenBank organism qualifier, including any disagreement with JSON.

genbank_ncbi_taxid.definition: Taxon cross-references in GenBank source qualifier.

source_record_accession.definition: Original nucleotide record accession/version, not the BGC accession.

bgc_start.definition: Original JSON BGC start coordinate; no coordinate-system conversion or inferred default.

bgc_end.definition: Original JSON BGC end coordinate; no inferred default.

bgc_completeness.definition: Original locus completeness, retaining Unknown separately from missing.

genbank_definition.definition: Frozen sequence description, retained for source conflict audit.

genbank_comment.definition: Original sequence warnings/comments; sequence replacement warnings are retained.

compound_names_original.definition: All original compound names, ordered JSON list; no synonym merging.

normalized_product_names.definition: Unicode NFC plus whitespace normalization only; no chemical name reassignment.

number_of_annotated_compounds.definition: Number of source BGC-compound relationship records, including all congeners.

molecular_mass.definition: Original source mol_mass values; no mass computation or unit reinterpretation.

SMILES.definition: Original source chemical structure strings; no structure generation.

chemical_structure_availability.definition: Availability of recorded structures, not new predictions.

source_mibig_biosynthetic_classes.definition: MIBiG 3.1 classes retained independently of frozen training labels.

source_saccharide_subclass.definition: Exact structured source Saccharide subclass; not replaced by curated primary category.

product_architecture.definition: Source-supported gross architecture; NOT_REVIEWED is not a negative call.

primary_chemotype.definition: Mutually exclusive curated category; independent from original model classes.

secondary_chemotype_tags.definition: Overlapping descriptors and ambiguity flags; do not add category counts as independent observations.

product_glycan_or_glycosylated_metabolit.definition: Distinguishes assembled glycan, glycometabolite, sugar precursor and non-glycosylated final product.

polymeric_or_nonpolymeric.definition: Gross source-supported architecture, not a computed molecular descriptor.

glycan_association_type.definition: Scope-specific relation; final-product chemistry and biosynthetic glycosylation are separate.

biological_localization_or_target.definition: Only documented glycan location scope; not inferred from a generic biosynthetic label.

bacterial_surface_glycan_related.definition: Explicit source-supported curation descriptor. True/False apply to documented product scope; NOT_DETERMINED and NOT_REVIEWED are not biological negatives.

bacterial_extracellular_glycan_related.definition: Explicit source-supported curation descriptor. True/False apply to documented product scope; NOT_DETERMINED and NOT_REVIEWED are not biological negatives.

surface_or_extracellular_glycan_combined.definition: Explicit source-supported curation descriptor. True/False apply to documented product scope; NOT_DETERMINED and NOT_REVIEWED are not biological negatives.

LPS_LOS_O_antigen_combined.definition: Explicit source-supported curation descriptor. True/False apply to documented product scope; NOT_DETERMINED and NOT_REVIEWED are not biological negatives.

chemotype_annotation_confidence.definition: Explicit source-supported curation descriptor. True/False apply to documented product scope; NOT_DETERMINED and NOT_REVIEWED are not biological negatives.

chemotype_evidence_source.definition: Explicit source-supported curation descriptor. True/False apply to documented product scope; NOT_DETERMINED and NOT_REVIEWED are not biological negatives.

known_monosaccharide_identities.definition: Only explicit curated source claims; missing means not reported/reviewed in inspected sources, not chemical absence. See long evidence table for scope, level and source.

unusual_or_rare_monosaccharides.definition: Only explicit curated source claims; missing means not reported/reviewed in inspected sources, not chemical absence. See long evidence table for scope, level and source.

amino_sugars.definition: Only explicit curated source claims; missing means not reported/reviewed in inspected sources, not chemical absence. See long evidence table for scope, level and source.

deoxy_sugars.definition: Only explicit curated source claims; missing means not reported/reviewed in inspected sources, not chemical absence. See long evidence table for scope, level and source.

sugar_nucleotide_precursors.definition: Only explicit curated source claims; missing means not reported/reviewed in inspected sources, not chemical absence. See long evidence table for scope, level and source.

reported_glycosidic_linkages.definition: Only explicit curated source claims; missing means not reported/reviewed in inspected sources, not chemical absence. See long evidence table for scope, level and source.

branching_or_polymeric_architecture.definition: Only explicit curated source claims; missing means not reported/reviewed in inspected sources, not chemical absence. See long evidence table for scope, level and source.

methylation.definition: Only explicit curated source claims; missing means not reported/reviewed in inspected sources, not chemical absence. See long evidence table for scope, level and source.

acetylation.definition: Only explicit curated source claims; missing means not reported/reviewed in inspected sources, not chemical absence. See long evidence table for scope, level and source.

sulfation.definition: Only explicit curated source claims; missing means not reported/reviewed in inspected sources, not chemical absence. See long evidence table for scope, level and source.

phosphorylation.definition: Only explicit curated source claims; missing means not reported/reviewed in inspected sources, not chemical absence. See long evidence table for scope, level and source.

other_glycan_tailoring_modifications.definition: Only explicit curated source claims; missing means not reported/reviewed in inspected sources, not chemical absence. See long evidence table for scope, level and source.

chemical_composition_evidence_level.definition: Chemical evidence levels distinguish primary experimental chemistry, literature annotation and review claims.

sugar_specificity_annotations.definition: Recorded enzyme substrate specificities and evidence; not silently treated as demonstrated product composition.

number_of_annotated_genes.definition: Number of CDS source annotations in the frozen GenBank BGC record; not the count of experimentally characterized enzymes.

number_of_explicit_MIBiG_gene_annotation.definition: Number of explicitly curated JSON gene annotations; distinguish from all CDS.

glycosyltransferase_genes.definition: Index of explicit source function descriptions. Roles may overlap; no sequence-based annotation and no absence claim.

nucleotide_sugar_biosynthesis_genes.definition: Index of explicit source function descriptions. Roles may overlap; no sequence-based annotation and no absence claim.

sugar_modification_genes.definition: Index of explicit source function descriptions. Roles may overlap; no sequence-based annotation and no absence claim.

glycan_polymerization_or_assembly_genes.definition: Index of explicit source function descriptions. Roles may overlap; no sequence-based annotation and no absence claim.

glycan_export_or_transport_genes.definition: Index of explicit source function descriptions. Roles may overlap; no sequence-based annotation and no absence claim.

other_biosynthetic_genes.definition: Index of explicit source function descriptions. Roles may overlap; no sequence-based annotation and no absence claim.

experimentally_characterized_enzymes.definition: Only genes with explicit source Activity assay evidence; knock-outs alone are not direct catalytic characterization.

pathway_description.definition: Source descriptions only; no new pathway reconstruction.

pathway_evidence_level.definition: Exact locus/BGC evidence list; not transferred to every enzyme or product claim.

pathway_source_annotations_json.definition: Lossless source pathway-class annotations including predictions; not newly calculated chemistry.

experimental_evidence_types.definition: Explicit source experimental/genetic/chemical evidence labels, excluding prediction, homology and inference. Aggregate labels do not imply every enzyme is characterized.
experimental_evidence_types.source: explicit JSON evidence arrays, experimental terms only

source_evidence_types_all.definition: Complete original source evidence vocabulary, retaining predictions/inferences separately from experimental_evidence_types.

publication_PMIDs.definition: Original source PubMed IDs; no replacement by retrieved identifiers.

publication_identifiers_original.definition: All original publication identifier strings, unchanged.

retrieved_publication_DOIs.definition: Supplemental PubMed metadata, kept separate from original DOI annotations.

source_record_URL.definition: Pinned official snapshot URL with archive member; current live records are not substituted.

source_record_SHA256.definition: SHA-256 of exact raw JSON record bytes.

source_version.definition: Single release used across all reference annotations.

curated_chemotype_status.definition: Rule-based or evidence-guided status is explicit; no human manual verification is claimed.

manual_review_required.definition: Records needing further human/scientific review, including unreviewed background entries.

curation_notes.definition: Accession-specific reasoning and unresolved evidence limits.

original_vs_mibig_class_disagreement.definition: Exact original/source class token-set disagreement; both remain unchanged.

JSON_GBK_organism_disagreement.definition: Exact source organism string disagreement; may reflect nomenclature or strain differences.
JSON_GBK_organism_disagreement.source: JSON organism versus GBK source organism

annotation_conflict_flag.definition: Recorded source or chemical-scope conflict; inspect notes and retained source values.
